exposure: Hours of labor stimulation prior to cesarean delivery
Cesarean delivery for arrest of dilation
Cervical dilation at time of cesarean delivery
outcome: Cervical dilatation at the time of cesarean delivery
Duration of labor stimulation before cesarean delivery for labor arrest
cohort: 13,269 women undergoing primary cesarean delivery at ≥37 weeks gestation from 13 university centers in the US (1999-2000)
finding: The study found that the majority of women (95%) who underwent cesarean delivery for labor arrest had either reached ≥6 cm cervical dilatation or received ≥6 hours of labor stimulation, aligning with the 2014 Obstetrics Care Consensus guidelines.
